entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: Who maketh  winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They  sing among the branches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the  service of man; That he may bring forth  food out of the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, [ And] oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man's heart.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of Jehovah are filled [with moisture], The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy  riches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play  therein.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou  takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: Let thy meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul.  Praise ye Jehovah.
